lessons.teacherScript: Hello, everyone! Welcome to a new world. Remember the clink, clank sound? We went over the hill, and look! A big wooden door with gears on it. This is the Gadget Workshop! Let's go inside. Tick, tock, click! Look at all the machines. This machine makes toys. Say it with me. This machine makes toys. Great! What does that machine do?
